# Create ledger: what Create needs, mapped to Horizon

**Mixins Create still needs on Horizon: 63/65** configured classes (strict API-contract baseline, not a claim that a Create port builds).

| Surface | Gap | Planned, not covered yet | Covered | Total |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Behaviour mixins | 19 | 11 | 1 | 31 |
| Accessor/invoker mixins | 21 | 12 | 1 | 34 |
| Access-transformer directives | 29 | 10 | 2 | 41 |
| Event listeners | 10 | 52 | 82 | 144 |
| Vanilla override declarations | 979 | 311 | 792 | 2082 |
| NeoForge extension declarations | 175 | 0 | 3 | 178 |

**Not covered:** NeoForge extensions 175/178; AT 39/41; event listeners 62/144 across 82 event classes; vanilla override declarations 1290/2082. Subclass inventory: 928 named/anonymous Create classes, 1178 class/base edges (360 direct), 118 vanilla bases.

## Baseline and reading the counts

- **Create:** [`mc1.21.1/dev` at `4148fd8d5b`](https://github.com/Creators-of-Create/Create/tree/4148fd8d5b05c85d88947edc00fb495a5074f57d), full commit `4148fd8d5b05c85d88947edc00fb495a5074f57d`. Its [code licence](https://github.com/Creators-of-Create/Create/blob/4148fd8d5b05c85d88947edc00fb495a5074f57d/LICENSE.md) is **MIT**; assets are all rights reserved and were not used. This ledger contains facts (paths, type/member names), not copied source.
- **Horizon:** fork main `07cd5491ebd24f6557479d7676a15922576afc4d`, upstream main `0bcd2f15678532560589773f674fb6290b075005`, Nov 2 snapshot. Read root `native-hooks.json` (the brief's `tools/native-hooks.json` path is obsolete) and all pending `tools/native-hook-fragments/` on both refs, plus #27, #28, #29 and #41. Bare #numbers refer to this fork; upstream references are written in full.
- **Refresh:** #48 covers one more mixin, 442 vanilla + 3 extension methods; #55 covers 89 state-only shape methods.
- **Covered** means the required entry point or native equivalent exists; not that its entire Create handler can already be ported. Handle services, custom content registration, rendering and networking remain dependencies. **Planned** names an open tracker/spec line; **in review (#N)** is its open-PR sub-state, never covered. All covered entries refer only to the named main snapshots, not PR heads. **Gap** needs a new contract. Similar names alone do not establish coverage.
- Mixins count once each; all 65 configured entries remain, including optional Xaero, datagen and migrations. **31 behaviour + 34 accessor/invoker** classes (33 `accessor.*` + XaeroFullscreenMapAccessor); access includes writes/calls. Two targets are NeoForge, two Xaero; the plugin is not a 66th mixin.
- AT counts **41 directives**, including class/constructor/final changes; unused declarations are retained and identified, not asserted to be current runtime needs.
- Listeners count event class + handler once, including instance references, typed/wrapper lambdas, FML and optional compat. Excludes Create-owned events and commented examples; side is intended execution. The seven event-publication sites are separate Host-service requirements.
- Override declarations are deduplicated across bases and independently attributed against public original-vanilla 1.21.1 API pages and NeoForge extension javadocs. Vanilla and NeoForge-patched contracts are counted separately. Includes anonymous/transitive Create inheritance and verified library bridges; unverified boundaries are listed separately. Create-local/bridge-only helpers and non-overriding overloads stay in a separate appendix; all 178 NeoForge extensions retain their own #41 part mappings. Removed 1.21 contracts are legacy requirements, not asserted 26.3 targets. Non-annotated methods require a matching inherited instance signature.
- **Exhaustive appendix:** proposed `docs/ledgers/create.md` and `docs/ledgers/create.tsv` documentation PR; review artifacts currently hold all paths/signatures/mappings.

## Library bridges

NeoForge ancestry is from **public 1.21.1 javadoc only** (evidence links in the appendix), not implementation source. Catnip ships inside pinned **Ponder 1.0.85+mc1.21.1**, `LICENSE_Ponder` **MIT**, Copyright 2022 The Create Team; its permissively licensed source proves the listed ancestry. Counts below are direct Create users; their transitive subclasses are included in §4. Bridge-only methods are excluded from engine overrides. Curios 9.2.2+1.21.1 is **LGPL-3.0-or-later**: only licence/manifest and Create-owned references were read, no ancestry is assumed. Event-bus javadocs were unavailable (404). ## Ten gap clusters with the most mixin leverage

Ranked by **distinct configured mixin classes** each cluster can remove, not lines of Java or estimated work. Clusters overlap; their counts must not be added. Planned clusters are included because they still require mixins today. A cluster closes a multi-purpose class only when its remaining contracts are also supplied.

| Rank | Gap cluster | Mixin classes affected | Kind of fix and 26.3 firing point / service |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| 1 | Model/armor/font render access and pose/trim customization | 11 | Render handles/parts at `HumanoidModel.setupAnim`, `HumanoidArmorLayer.renderArmorPiece`, `EquipmentLayerRenderer.renderLayers`, `AvatarRenderer.getArmPose`. ArmorTrim, AgeableListModel, EntityRenderDispatcher, Font, Gui, HumanoidArmorLayer accessor+behaviour, ItemModelGenerators, LevelRenderer accessor, HumanoidModel, PlayerRenderer. |
| 2 | Legacy schema/component migration and datagen | 9 | Registration at `V1460.registerEntities/registerBlockEntities`, `BlockPosFormatAndRenamesFix.makeRule`, `ItemStackComponentizationFix.fixItemStack`, modern stack decode. Those three plus ItemStack, Ingredient.Value, BlockLootSubProvider, MappedRegistry, ItemModelGenerators, SystemReport (diagnostics). |
| 3 | Moving-structure contact, picking and rider geometry | 6 | #27 + mutable pick/contact: `Entity.move/spawnSprintParticle`, `Player.aiStep`/pose-fit, `Mob.getAttackBoundingBox(double)`, `ProjectileUtil.getEntityHitResult`, `Minecraft.pick(float)`. Entity, EntityContraptionInteraction, Player, Mob, ProjectileUtil, GameRenderer. |
| 4 | Recipe/brewing/dispenser introspection | 5 | Handles/services, not broadcast. PotionBrewing mix enumeration/isContainer, shaped recipe pattern, dispenser behavior lookup and projectile configuration, and datagen ingredient builder. Closes PotionBrewing, ShapedRecipe, DispenserBlock, ProjectileDispenseBehavior, Ingredient.Value (datagen codec also required). |
| 5 | Fluid simulation and reaction lookup | 3 | Fluid service + passability broadcast: `FlowingFluid.getNewLiquid` and `canPassThrough` (26.3 getNewLiquid line 160 / canPassThrough line 319); native reaction registry replaces NeoForge FluidInteractionRegistry access. Covers FlowingFluidAccessor, FluidInteractionRegistryAccessor, WaterWheelFluidSpreadMixin. |
| 6 | Fake-player placement/drop-capture and complete use context | 3 | #27 hand/hit + #29 fake-player + drop capture at `BlockItem.place`/`Block.popResource`. BlockItem, Block, UseOnContext (Beehive smoke separate). |
| 7 | Diving movement/environment decisions | 3 | Broadcast fire-immunity/fluid-travel/underwater query hooks at `Entity.fireImmune`, `LivingEntity.travelInFluid` after lava move, and `LocalPlayer.isUnderWater`/inherited fluid query. Covers EntityMixin (also needs seat contact), LavaSwimming, HeavyBootsOnPlayer. |
| 8 | Optional Xaero addon contract | 3 | Addon-provided camera/map render service and screen pause part; target `GuiMap` is not vanilla. `Screen.isPauseScreen` is the vanilla pause-policy boundary. Covers all three Xaero mixins; no Xaero implementation was read. |
| 9 | Multi-position destruction-progress lifecycle | 2 | Client progress part/storage + insertion/removal hooks at `ClientLevel.destroyBlockProgress` and `removeProgress` (moved from LevelRenderer); covers LevelRendererMixin and BlockDestructionProgressMixin, not server `block_break_progress_update`. |
| 10 | Use-effect replacement and vanilla item particles | 2 | Broadcast at `Consumable.shouldEmitParticlesAndSounds/emitParticlesAndSounds` (replaces old LivingEntity methods) + LivingRef.spawn_item_particles. CustomItemUseEffects, LivingEntityAccessor. |

**Estimated best return per unit of work:** (1) recipe/brewing/dispenser introspection (five mixins, mostly read services), (2) multi-position destruction progress (two mixins, one lifecycle), (3) fluid simulation/reaction queries (three mixins, shared fluid boundary).
